summary: Soft email verification + forgot/reset password flows tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest assertions passed for /register, /me, /verify-email (HTML page + DB flip), /resend-verification (auth-guard, already-verified, 502-in-preview expected), /forgot-password (no enumeration, writes reset_token), /reset-password (HTML form page, short-pw 400, invalid-token 400, success + new-login + session invalidation). Frontend (tablet 1024x768): /login 'Forgot password?' panel opens, empty-email guard fires, sending returns 'Check your inbox' + 'Back to sign in' works. Dashboard VerifyEmailBanner CORRECTLY HIDDEN for verified demo (greenlantern) and CORRECTLY VISIBLE for an unverified password user; Resend surfaces graceful 'Couldn't send the email right now' on the expected 502; dismiss hides the banner. All testIDs (forgot-open, forgot-send, forgot-done, verify-email-banner, verify-resend, verify-dismiss) resolve. Note: newly registered users are routed to /onboarding first (onboarded=false), so the banner is only reachable after onboarding completes and the user lands on '/'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears on /login (and likely global via src/theme shadow helper). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow.card / shadow.glow usage across screens including /app/frontend/app/login.tsx, /app/frontend/app/index.tsx).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate the theme's shadow.* style props to boxShadow for React Native Web to eliminate deprecation warnings.
(Optional UX) Consider whether the VerifyEmailBanner should also appear during /onboarding for new password users — currently they only see it after they land on '/' post-onboarding.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: forgot-password uses password-provider-only gating and always returns 200 (good — no account enumeration).
auth.py: reset-password invalidates all existing sessions on success (good — prevents stale-session hijack after a leaked password reset).
auth.py: verify-email is idempotent-safe — bad/missing/expired tokens all render a friendly HTML page with 200, never a 500.

emailer.py: send_email correctly returns False on integration proxy 401/HTTPStatusError; callers wrap in try/except so email-send failures never leak to clients (except /resend-verification which converts to 502 by design).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_verify_reset.py (new pytest module for verify + forgot/reset flows)
seed_data_creation: Created 3 ephemeral test users (test_verify_*, test_resend_*, test_reset_*, test_banner_*) during pytest and browser testing — ALL deleted at end. Demo account greenlantern@roujaune.app confirmed intact: assigned_plan_id='couch-to-road', email_verified=true, provider=password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: In PREVIEW the EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is invalid, so real email sends return 502. That is EXPECTED. To validate flows, read verify_token/reset_token directly from Mongo (test_database.users) then hit the GET pages / POST endpoints. Web token localStorage key is 'roujaune_token'. New password users land on /onboarding first — flip onboarded=true in Mongo (or complete onboarding) to reach the '/' dashboard where VerifyEmailBanner renders.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The observed 502 from /resend-verification and 401 from the Emergent email proxy are by design in the preview environment (email key injected at deploy time).
